news.summary: Microsoft Research released Agent Lightning v1.0, a lightweight RL framework that connects existing agents to reinforcement learning training without extensive rework. The framework is designed to streamline training of AI agents, reducing the engineering effort needed to build custom RL pipelines.
news.enterprise_use: Consider evaluating Agent Lightning for internal AI projects that could benefit from faster RL iteration, especially if you already have agents that could plug into this framework. This could reduce time-to-train and lower the barrier to experimenting with new agent capabilities in your IT operations or automation workflows.
